Function: GetCurrentInputForFrameInputLogSlot at 1403f0680
Signature: uint __fastcall GetCurrentInputForFrameInputLogSlot(ALuxBattleFrameInputLog * pInputLog, int nSlot)
Entry: 1403f0680
Body: 1403f0680 - 1403f071c

plate.comment:
Reads current input for one ALuxBattleFrameInputLog slot from BattleManager-owned sources.

Algorithm:
1. Resolve BattleManager from pInputLog->pUE4Component_at0x388.
2. If BM->pBattleFrameInput exists, read slotRecords[nSlot].dwCurrentInput at BM+0x450 -> +0x3E0 + slot*0x90.
3. If BM->PlayerRecordsBase_at0x440 exists, OR in 0x4000 when paired forward/rewind UI bits are set for the slot.
4. Clear any bits masked by pInputLog->dwForwardReverseBitfield_at0x394.

Parameters:
  pInputLog: ALuxBattleFrameInputLog * - input-log actor/cache object.
  nSlot: int - player slot index.

Returns:
  uint: current input bitfield after replay UI augmentation and InputLog mask-out.

Structure Layout:
  Offset | Size | Field | Type | Description
  BM+0x440 | 8 | PlayerRecordsBase_at0x440 | pointer | Per-slot replay/player UI records; stride 0xA8 in this function.
  BM+0x450 | 8 | pBattleFrameInput | ALuxBattleFrameInput_Partial * | Upstream current-input actor.
  FrameInput+0x3E0 | 0x90 stride | pSlotRecords[n].dwCurrentInput | uint | Current input for slot n.
  InputLog+0x394 | 4 | dwForwardReverseBitfield | uint | Bits cleared from final result.

Special Cases:
  - PlayerRecordsBase + slot*0xA8 + 0x394/0x398 bit pairs add 0x4000 for replay forward/rewind UI conflict state.
  - This function reads state only. ProcessFrameInputLogCurrentInputRefresh writes the returned value into pInputLog+0x3B8.
